key_difference: (D) adds a new clearNativeLocks() helper and retries unlink only on EBUSY after explicitly dropping the lock, while (B) consolidates unlink, close and the warning into a single releaseLockFile() that closes the fd first and then retries on EBUSY/ETXTBSY/EPERM, treating ENOENT/ENOTDIR as success in both callers.
